2608.30873.title: Personas Differ from Native-Language Generation: Language Pathways Shape LLM Interpersonal Advice
2608.30873.paper_summary: LLMs are increasingly used for interpersonal advice and as tools for studying social behavior across languages and cultures. A common shortcut for eliciting language- or culture-related variation is to ask a model to answer as a native speaker. We test whether this native-speaker persona reproduces the outputs obtained when models instead generate advice in the target language and translate the response back into English. Using 600 interpersonal advice questions across 13 languages and eight LLMs, we compare native-language generation followed by translation (NL) with native-speaker persona prompting (NP), measuring linguistic style, behavioral scaffolding, and forced-choice action recommendations. We find that NP and NL are not interchangeable. Compared to NL, NP often increases lexical social cues, including affiliation and positive tone, while reducing qualities such as concreteness and social attunement; NP also provides less actionable scaffolding in open-ended advice. In forced-choice scenarios, NP changes which action the model selects, favoring confrontation over redirection, with effect sizes varying across languages, topics, and models. Our results show that cross-lingual elicitation strategy is a consequential methodological choice that can change both how advice is framed and which actions models recommend.
2608.30873.paper_summary_zh: LLMs 正在越來越多地用於人際建議以及作為研究跨語言和文化社會行為的工具。<lb/>一個常見的簡化方法是要求模型以母語者的身份回答問題，以引出與語言或文化相關的變化。<lb/>我們測試這種母語者角色是否能重現模型在目標語言中生成建議並將回應翻譯回英語時所獲得的輸出。<lb/>使用 600 個人際建議問題，涵蓋 13 種語言和八個 LLM，我們比較了母語生成後翻譯（NL）與母語者角色提示（NP），測量語言風格、行為支架和強制選擇行動建議。<lb/>我們發現 NP 和 NL 不是可以互換的。<lb/>與 NL 相比，NP 通常增加了詞彙社會線索，包括隸屬感和積極語調，同時減少了具體性和社會調適等特質；在開放式建議中，NP 也提供了較少的可行性支架。<lb/>在強制選擇情境中，NP 改變了模型選擇的行動，偏向於對抗而非重定向，效果大小在不同語言、主題和模型之間有所變化。<lb/>我們的結果顯示，跨語言引導策略是一個重要的方法選擇，能改變建議的框架以及模型推薦的行動。
